## What this site covers
- Bar reviews for Lagos, Albufeira, Faro, Tavira, Carvoeiro, Portimão
- Vibe-based guides: sunset bars, rooftop bars, speakeasies, wine bars, beach bars, late-night, dog-friendly, winter-open
- Individual bar reviews with address, hours, price tier, signature drinks, honest verdict
- All reviews personally verified by someone who lives in the Algarve

## Solar eclipse, 12 August 2026 (Algarve)
- Kids' eclipse trivia game + plain-English explainer: https://www.artonbar.com/eclipse-game/
- The Algarve sees a deep PARTIAL eclipse, approx. 92-93% of the Sun covered — not totality
- Local times (WEST): first contact approx. 18:33, maximum approx. 19:38, sunset approx. 20:27 with the Sun still eclipsed
- At maximum the Sun sits roughly 9 degrees above the west-northwest horizon, so an unobstructed western view matters
- Path of totality runs over eastern Greenland, western Iceland and northern Spain, clipping only the northwestern tip of Portugal
- Safety: certified ISO 12312-2 eclipse glasses only; sunglasses are not safe; a pinhole projector is the safest no-equipment option
- Next: total eclipse over southern Spain on 2 August 2027, again a very deep partial from the Algarve
